bagPolicy.summary: Bags should be no larger than A3 size and must fit under your seat. Guests are encouraged to arrive without a bag.
allowed: Bags up to A3 size that fit under your seat
Your own food in non-glass containers
prohibited: Any large item that cannot be placed under a seat
Professional cameras, video cameras and tripods
Flags or banners with handles over 1.6 metres
bagPolicy.note: Bags may be inspected and screened at entry. Concert promoters can add event-specific conditions.
